meta.title: WoodRoute — Production management for your workshop
meta.description: Manage orders, inventory, and timelines in one place. WoodRoute's feasibility assistant helps you decide before accepting every order.

hero.title: Make better decisions in your workshop. From the very first order.
hero.subtitle: Manage orders, inventory, and timelines in one place. WoodRoute validates whether an order is feasible before you accept it.

problem.title: Workshop chaos has a real cost
problem.subtitle: Every woodworker knows the story: miscalculated materials, clients calling to ask, deadlines missed.

items.title: Notebooks and WhatsApp
items.description: You track orders in paper notes or lost messages. Finding information costs you minutes every time.

items.title: Miscalculated materials
items.description: You accept an order and halfway through realize you don't have enough material. The order delays, the client gets frustrated.

items.title: Clients in the dark
items.description: You receive the same message over and over: 'When will it be ready?' Every answer interrupts your work.

items.title: No visibility into your shop
items.description: You don't know clearly what orders are in progress, what's in stock, or how much capacity you have available.

how_it_works.title: From request to delivery, no surprises

steps.title: Register the order
steps.description: Enter the furniture details: materials, dimensions, and estimated date.

steps.title: Validate feasibility
steps.description: WoodRoute checks your stock, available capacity, and timelines. It tells you whether you can accept the order.

steps.title: Produce with control
steps.description: Manage the order's progress, deduct materials from inventory, and get alerts when stock runs low.

steps.title: Your client sees the progress
steps.description: Share a tracking link. Your client follows the status in real time without needing to call you.

items.title: Feasibility assistant
items.description: Before accepting an order, validates whether you have the required materials, time, and capacity.

items.title: Order management
items.description: All your orders in one place. Status, materials, deadlines, and client info always visible.

items.title: Inventory control
items.description: Track your materials and get alerts when stock reaches the defined minimum.

items.title: Time estimation
items.description: Automatically calculates the order duration based on complexity and your current workload.

items.title: Client tracking
items.description: A public link where clients see the status of their furniture. No unnecessary calls.

items.title: Stock alerts
items.description: Receive notifications before running out of key materials, not after it happens.

client_tracking.title: Your client knows exactly where their furniture is
client_tracking.subtitle: Share a tracking link and that's it. No extra apps, no sign-up. Your client sees the status in real time.
